result.summary: Refactors transaction input and output initialization in txpackage_tests, bench/duplicate_inputs, and script_p2sh_tests. Replaces procedural resize and field assignments with declarative constructor calls for COutPoint, CTxIn, and CTxOut without changing the resulting transactions.
result.problem: Test and benchmark transactions are set up using verbose, procedural field-by-field mutations and vector resizes, which is harder to read and inconsistent with declarative initialization patterns.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data')
Follow-up to merged PR #36750 ('test: construct multisig_tests inputs/outputs declaratively')
result.card: This PR refactors transaction input and output initialization in txpackage unit tests, script_p2sh unit tests, and the duplicate_inputs benchmark to use declarative constructor calls instead of procedural field-by-field assignments. It continues test boilerplate cleanups tracked in issue #36692 and follows merged PR #36750. All constructed transactions remain identical, with no change to test coverage or behavior.

risk.why: A typo could cause a unit test or benchmark to construct an unintended transaction and produce an unexpected test failure.
